understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to progress through every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+', with all goals occupied simultaneously to trigger a win.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement shifted the currently selected piece by one grid cell, while walls and boundaries could block movement. Adjacent pushable blocks could be moved by pushing them, and selectable pieces could be switched using CLICK with their pixel coordinates. Movement-blocked hints were not always definitive, so actions had to be tested directly.
